author: Inside Edition
description: A deputy rushes to the scene of an accident, where time is of the essence. Deputy Threatt of the Chester County Sheriff's Office in South Carolina says once he saw the car on fire, he knew he would have to act fast. He called out to the person in the car to tell her to get to him. While the woman was able to reach the deputy, she became tangled in her seatbelt. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Deputy Cuts Woman From Seatbelt To Free Her From Burning Car

author: Inside Edition
description: Little Amiah Hankins got her ears pierced for her fourth birthday. A few weeks later, the little girl swallowed one of the earrings. The other earring was stuck up her nose. A pediatrician did not have the right equipment so mom had to drive Amiah to the hospital. Fortunately the doctor was able to remove the earring in Amiah's nose with special forceps. As for the earring she swallowed, nature took its course and dealt with that one.
title: 4-Year-Old Gets Ears Pierced: 1 Earring Ends Up In Her Stomach, The Other Up Her Nose
